unknown: Something unexpected happened. Try again; if it happens again, open Settings › About › technical logs and contact DZBuild support.
internal_error: Something went wrong inside DZBuild POS and this action stopped. Try again; if it happens again, restart DZBuild POS.
database_error: The shop's data could not be saved or read for this action. Try again; if it happens again, restart DZBuild POS.
database_busy: DZBuild POS is still saving. Wait a second, then try again.
database_corrupt: The file that holds the shop's data is damaged, so DZBuild POS did not open it. Do not repair or replace it yourself: contact DZBuild support, who will restore your latest backup safely.
database_newer_than_app: This data was saved by a newer version of DZBuild POS. Install the latest version.
io_error: A file could not be read or written. Check the free disk space and try again.
constraint_violation: This change clashes with data already saved (for example a code already used). Check the values, then try again.
datapack_invalid: The regulatory data (TVA rates, stamp duty, regulated prices) is damaged. Reinstall DZBuild POS.
backup_dir_missing: No backup folder is set. Restart DZBuild POS.
backup_invalid: This backup is damaged and cannot be used. Choose another one.
memory_database: This action needs the shop's data file on this PC. Restart DZBuild POS.
restore_needs_attention: A restore was interrupted, so DZBuild POS did not open the data. Do not change anything in the data folder: open it and contact DZBuild support.
record_not_found: This item no longer exists. Refresh the page.
user_not_found: This user no longer exists. Refresh the page.
role_not_found: This role no longer exists. Refresh the page.
backup_not_found: This backup file is missing. Refresh the list.
insufficient_permission: Your role does not allow this action. Ask the owner or a manager.
session_required: Your session has ended. Log in again.
session_invalid: Your session is no longer valid. Log in again.
invalid_credentials: Unknown user. Tap your name in the list.
user_inactive: This user is deactivated. Ask the owner to reactivate it.
too_many_attempts: Too many wrong PINs. Wait 5 minutes and try again.
approver_lacks_permission: This person cannot approve this action. Ask the owner or a manager.
override_self_not_allowed: You cannot approve your own request. Ask another manager.
owner_only: Only an owner can do this: manage owner accounts and roles, or restore a backup.
username_taken: This login name is already used. Choose another one.
last_owner: The shop must keep one active owner. Give the owner role to someone else first.
cannot_deactivate_self: You cannot deactivate your own account. Ask another owner.
owner_role_locked: The owner role always has every permission and cannot be changed.
system_role_locked: Built-in roles cannot be removed. Create a new role instead.
role_in_use: Users still have this role. Give them another role first.
role_name_taken: A role with this name already exists in this language. Choose another name.
setup_already_done: The first setup is already done. Log in to continue.
too_long: This text is too long. Shorten it.
pin_format: The PIN must have 4 to 8 digits.
pin_too_simple: This PIN is too easy to guess (like 1111 or 1234). Choose another one.
nif_invalid: The NIF must have 15 digits (18 for a secondary establishment).
nis_invalid: The NIS must have 15 or 18 digits.
email_invalid: This email address is not valid. Check it.
wilaya_invalid: Choose a wilaya from the list.
amount_invalid: Enter a positive amount, for example 1 000 000,00.
discount_limit_invalid: The discount must be between 0 and 100 %.
username_invalid: The login name needs 2 to 32 characters without spaces.
setting_unknown: This setting does not exist. Update DZBuild POS.
value_invalid: This value is not allowed for this setting.
logo_invalid: The logo must be a PNG or JPEG image.
logo_too_large: The logo is larger than 512 KB. Choose a smaller image.
price_mode_locked: The price entry mode (incl. or excl. VAT) can no longer change: products already have prices or tickets are numbered.
unit_not_found: This unit does not exist. Choose a unit from the list.
tax_rate_not_found: This VAT rate does not exist. Choose a rate from the list.
price_level_not_found: This price level does not exist or was archived.
category_not_found: This category does not exist or was archived.
code_taken: This code is already used. Choose another one.
unit_in_use: Products use this unit: its decimals cannot be reduced.
price_level_is_default: This is the default price level. Make another one the default before archiving it.
category_cycle: A category cannot be placed inside one of its own sub-categories.
category_has_children: This category has sub-categories. Archive them first.
product_not_found: Product not found. Check the code or search by name.
reference_taken: This reference is already used by another product.
barcode_taken: This barcode is already used by another product.
barcode_invalid: Invalid barcode, or too wide for the label: digits and letters without spaces, 48 characters at most. Fix it on the product, or use a wider label.
plu_taken: This PLU number is already used by another product.
qty_invalid: Invalid quantity for this unit (for example 1.5 pieces). Correct the quantity.
unit_not_weighable: A weighed product needs a unit with decimals (kg, litre, metre).
variant_parent_required: A variant must belong to a model product. Choose the model.
components_required: A kit must contain at least one component.
component_invalid: Invalid component: choose a stocked product, once.
tax_rate_inactive: This VAT rate no longer applies. Choose an active rate.
product_not_sellable: This product is not sold at the till (a model, or turned off for the till).
product_kind_locked: This product already has stock movements or sales: its type and unit can no longer change.
discount_invalid: Invalid discount: between 0 and 100%, and no more than the line amount.
payment_method_invalid: This payment method cannot be used here.
customers_not_available: Customer credit and store credit come with customer management. Take another payment for now.
cheque_details_required: For a cheque, enter its number, the bank and the date.
transfer_reference_required: For a transfer, enter its reference.
non_cash_exceeds_total: Card, cheque or transfer payments exceed the total: change is only given in cash.
payment_insufficient: The payment does not cover the amount due (stamp duty included). Add the rest.
stock_insufficient: Not enough stock for some products. Lower the quantity or adjust the stock.
stock_location_not_found: This stock location does not exist or was archived.
product_not_stocked: This product has no stock (a service, a model or a kit).
stock_not_zero: This product still has stock. Bring its stock to zero (count or stock-out) before archiving it or stopping stock tracking.
product_archived: This product is archived. Restore it before changing its stock.
document_not_found: Document not found. Check the number.
document_already_validated: This document is already validated and cannot change. Make a return or a credit note.
document_not_validated: This document is not validated and cannot be printed.
cash_session_closed: The register is closed. Open a cash session to sell.
cash_session_already_open: A cash session is already open on this till.
setup_required: Finish the shop setup before selling.
cart_empty: The cart is empty. Add an item.
price_override_not_allowed: You cannot change the price. Ask a manager to approve.
free_line_not_allowed: You cannot sell an item outside the catalogue. Ask a manager to approve.
discount_not_allowed: You cannot give a discount. Ask a manager to approve.
discount_above_limit: This discount is above your limit. Ask a manager to approve.
held_cart_not_found: This held ticket no longer exists on this till.
return_original_invalid: This document cannot be returned: scan a validated receipt.
return_line_invalid: This line is not part of the original receipt.
return_qty_exceeds_sold: You cannot return more than the quantity sold (minus earlier returns).
return_without_receipt_not_allowed: A return without receipt needs a manager's approval.
variance_needs_approval: The cash difference is above the threshold. Count again or ask a manager to approve.
count_invalid: Invalid number of notes or coins.
printer_not_configured: No receipt printer is set up. Choose one in Settings › Hardware.
printer_not_found: Windows cannot find this printer. Check its name in Settings › Hardware or reinstall its driver.
printer_offline: The printer does not answer. Check that it is on, plugged in and has paper, then reprint.
printer_io_error: Sending to the printer failed. Check the cable and the paper, then reprint.
printer_timeout: The printer did not answer in time. Check that it is on and connected, then reprint.
printer_setting_invalid: This printer setting is not valid. Correct the field shown.
port_unavailable: This port does not exist or another program is using it. Choose another port or close the other program.
printer_raw_unsupported: This printer's Windows driver refuses direct printing. Install the manufacturer's driver or "Generic / Text Only".
logo_unreadable: The logo cannot be printed. Choose a PNG or JPEG image in Settings › Shop.
render_failed: The receipt could not be prepared for printing. Try again; if it happens again, contact DZBuild support.
hardware_unsupported: This kind of connection is not available on this computer. Choose another connection.
hardware_config_invalid: The hardware settings file is damaged. Set the printer up again in Settings › Hardware.
print_not_pending: This receipt has already been printed. Use Reprint to print a duplicate.
phone_invalid: This phone number is not valid. Enter 10 digits for a mobile (0555 12 34 56) or 9 for a landline (021 23 45 67).
date_invalid: This date is not valid. Pick a day in the calendar.
opening_already_set: The opening balance of this account is already recorded. Correct it with an adjustment.
allocation_invalid: One of the chosen sales does not belong to this account or is already settled. Reload the list and choose again.
ledger_entry_not_found: This entry does not exist in the account. Reload the statement and try again.
customer_not_found: This customer does not exist or was archived. Search again.
supplier_not_found: This supplier does not exist or was archived. Search again.
phone_taken: Another customer already has this phone number. Open their file or enter another number.
balance_not_zero: This account is not settled. Collect the rest or adjust the balance before archiving.
customer_required: Choose the customer first (F3): credit, store credit and this payment method are for known customers only.
customer_blocked: This customer is blocked for credit. Take another payment or unblock them in their file.
credit_limit_exceeded: This sale goes over the customer's credit limit. Take part of it now or ask a manager to approve.
store_credit_insufficient: The customer's store credit does not cover this amount. Lower the part paid with store credit.
change_too_large: The change is above the limit set by the shop. Check the amount typed.
image_invalid: This file is not a readable image. Choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo.
image_too_large: This image is too large (8 MB and 8000 pixels at most). Choose a smaller photo.
variant_axes_invalid: Give 1 to 3 criteria (size, colour…) with at least one value each, 200 combinations at most.
promotion_not_found: This promotion no longer exists. Reload the list.
promotion_dates_required: A seasonal sale, a clearance or an unpacking sale has a start and an end date. Enter both.
campaign_has_sales: This campaign has already sold: its prices, type and first day are declared and can no longer change. For a second price cut, create a new campaign.
price_below_floor: This price is below the product's minimum price. Ask a manager to approve or keep the listed price.
lot_required: This product is tracked by lot. Enter the lot number (and its expiry date).
lot_expired: Only expired lots of this product are left. Take them off the shelf or change the rule in Settings › Sales and cash.
lot_not_found: This lot does not exist for this product. Check the lot number.
serials_count_mismatch: Enter one serial number per piece, only for products tracked by serial number.
serial_taken: This serial number is already recorded for this product. Check it.
serial_not_found: This serial number is not recorded for this product.
serial_status_invalid: This serial number cannot go through this operation now (already sold, returned or sent back).
purchase_order_invalid: This purchase order cannot be used here (a draft, cancelled or from another supplier). Choose another one.
purchase_line_invalid: A line does not match the chosen document. Reload it and start again.
receipt_already_invoiced: This goods receipt is already on a supplier invoice.
supplier_invoice_duplicate: An invoice from this supplier already has this number. Check the invoice number.
serial_not_at_location: This serial number is not in stock at this location. Check the location or the serial number.
count_not_found: This stock count does not exist. Reload the list.
count_open_exists: A stock count is already open for this location. Finish or cancel it first.
count_closed: This stock count is closed: it can no longer change.
transfer_same_location: Choose two different locations for the transfer.
expense_category_not_found: This expense category no longer exists. Choose another one.
expense_not_found: This expense does not exist. Reload the list.
expense_session_closed: The cash session of this expense is closed and its Z can no longer change. Record the money put back as a cash in on the open session.
report_range_invalid: Choose a valid period: the end date after the start date, five years at most.
report_filter_required: This report needs a choice: select the stock count or the promotion.
import_file_unreadable: This file cannot be read. Save it as .xlsx or .csv and try again.
import_file_too_large: File too large or too wide (50 MB, 200,000 rows and 512 columns at most). Split it into several files or clear the cells filled far from the table.
import_sheet_not_found: This sheet is not in the file. Choose another one.
import_mapping_invalid: The columns changed since the check, or a required column is missing. Check the file again.
import_undo_not_allowed: Only today's latest import can be undone.
backup_file_invalid: This file is not a valid DZBuild POS backup, or it is damaged.
hardware_setting_invalid: A hardware setting is not valid. Correct it in Settings › Hardware.
scale_not_configured: No scale is set up. Choose one in Settings › Hardware.
scale_not_responding: The scale does not answer. Check that it is on and plugged in, then try again.
scale_unstable: The weight is not stable. Wait until the item stops moving, then weigh again.
scale_command_unsupported: This scale does not take this command. Use the scale's own key.
scale_overload: The scale is overloaded. Take some weight off, then weigh again.
display_not_configured: No pole display is set up. Choose one in Settings › Hardware.
collector_file_invalid: The data collector file cannot be read: it is too big, or its lines are not written as code;quantity. Export it again from the collector.
label_printer_not_configured: No label printer is set up. Choose one in Settings › Hardware.
printer_driver_only: This printer only takes pages: the ticket goes through the Windows driver.
delivery_already_invoiced: This delivery note is already invoiced. Open its invoice in the archive.
ticket_already_invoiced: This receipt already has an invoice. Reprint it from the archive.
mentions_missing: Mandatory mentions are missing on the invoice. Complete the shop or customer details.
vat_exempt_ref_required: A VAT-exempt customer needs the number of the exemption attestation.
document_kind_invalid: This kind of document is not made here.
document_not_convertible: This document cannot be converted that way.
quote_expired: This quote has expired. Convert it at today's prices or make a new one.
delivery_customer_mismatch: These delivery notes belong to different customers: invoice them separately.
ticket_returned: Goods of this receipt were already returned: it can no longer be invoiced.
ticket_invoiced: This receipt is invoiced: issue a credit note on its invoice.
ticket_vat_exempt_buyer: This customer is exempt from TVA and this receipt carries TVA: return the receipt, then type an invoice for this customer, without TVA.
ticket_customer_mismatch: Part of this receipt is on credit on another customer's account: invoice it to that customer.
document_tax_context_changed: The shop's tax regime or the customer's VAT exemption changed since this draft was priced. Open it and save it again (or convert it at today's prices) before validating it.
invoice_not_creditable: Only a validated invoice can receive a credit note.
credit_line_invalid: This line is not on the invoice.
credit_exceeds_invoice: The credit note exceeds what is left on the invoice.
warranty_not_set: No item of this document has a warranty. Set its duration on the product.
warranty_document_invalid: A warranty certificate is made from a validated receipt or invoice.
archive_range_invalid: Choose a period shorter than five years, its start before its end.
export_too_large: This export is over one million rows. Choose a shorter period and export it in several parts.
print_host_unavailable: A4 printing could not start. Close and reopen the app, then try again.
print_render_timeout: The document took too long to prepare. Try again.
print_render_failed: The document could not be laid out. Try again; if it happens again, export a diagnostic.
printer_unavailable: The printer cannot be found or is offline. Check that it is on or choose another one.
print_failed: Printing failed. Check the printer and try again.
pdf_failed: The PDF could not be written. Choose another folder and try again.
print_timeout: The print did not answer in time. Check the printer before printing again: if the sheet came out it counts, and the next copy will read “DUPLICATA”.
prefix_taken: This prefix is already used by another format.
scale_plu_unknown: No product has this label's PLU. Enter the PLU on the product.
scale_product_not_weighed: This product is not sold by weight. Tick "Sold by weight" (in kg) on the product.
scale_price_missing: This product has no price per kilo. Enter its price before scanning the label.
labels_empty: No label to print. Pick at least one product.
labels_too_many: Too many labels at once ({{total}}, at most {{max}}). Print in several batches.
label_source_not_printable: Only a validated goods receipt can give labels.
label_arabic_required: These food or regulated products need an Arabic label (décret 13-378). Pick an Arabic + French template, or confirm.
label_arabic_name_missing: These food or regulated products have no Arabic name, so their label would be in French only (décret 13-378). Add their Arabic name on the product, or confirm.
label_template_not_found: This label template no longer exists. Pick another one.
scale_plu_required: Give this product a PLU number first.
scale_hotkey_taken: This scale key is already used by another product.
cloud_unavailable: DZBuild is not answering. Check the Internet connection: the till keeps selling and everything will be sent later.
cloud_unauthorized: DZBuild refused access. Link the store again in Settings › DZBuild.
cloud_not_ready: Not available on DZBuild yet. The data waits here and will be sent as soon as it is.
cloud_plan_cap: Your DZBuild plan limits active online products. The others were published as drafts: change plan on dzbuild.com to activate them.
cloud_not_linked: The till is not linked to a DZBuild store. Link it in Settings › DZBuild.
cloud_already_linked: The till is already linked to a DZBuild store. Unlink it first to choose another one.
cloud_link_expired: The link request expired. Start again and approve within 10 minutes.
cloud_link_denied: Access was denied on DZBuild. Only the store owner can approve the till.
cloud_state_mismatch: This sign-in does not belong to the link started on this till. Start linking again from the till.
cloud_discovery_invalid: DZBuild's sign-in page does not answer as expected. Try again later; if it continues, contact DZBuild support.
cloud_config_invalid: This version cannot connect to DZBuild. Install the latest version.
cloud_relink_required: The DZBuild link expired or was cancelled. Link the store again: nothing is lost.
cloud_store_not_found: This store is not in your DZBuild account. Pick one from the list.
cloud_request_invalid: DZBuild refused this data. Open the details to see what to fix.
cloud_rate_limited: Too many requests to DZBuild. Sending starts again by itself in a minute.
cloud_secret_store_failed: Windows could not store the link safely (Windows Credential Manager). Restart the PC, then link the store again.
cloud_attempt_not_found: This link request no longer exists. Start again.
cloud_response_invalid: Unexpected answer from DZBuild. Try again later; if it keeps happening, export a diagnostic for support.
cloud_order_not_found: Online order not found. Refresh the list.
cloud_order_claimed_elsewhere: Another till is already preparing this order.
cloud_order_prepaid: This order is already paid online: do not take payment, hand it over (at the shop or to the courier).
cloud_order_state_invalid: This action is no longer possible for this order. Refresh the list.
cloud_order_unmapped_product: An item of the order is not in the till's catalogue. Import the online products from Settings › DZBuild.
cloud_outbox_item_not_found: This upload no longer exists. Refresh the list.
host_required: This is done on the main PC. Reconnect this till to the main PC, or do it on the main PC.
lan_version_mismatch: This PC and the main PC run different versions of DZBuild POS. Update both; selling goes on meanwhile.
replay_out_of_order: The main PC is waiting for an earlier operation of this till. Sending goes on by itself, in order.
replay_forbidden_row: The main PC refused an operation of this till because it changed another PC's data. Tell the owner.
replay_invalid: The main PC refused an operation of this till because it breaks the shop's rules. Tell the owner.
replay_document_mismatch: A receipt of this till was changed after it was made: the main PC refused it and changed nothing. Tell the owner.
replay_conflict: The main PC already has a different copy of this operation. Tell the owner.
lan_token_invalid: The main PC no longer recognises this till. Join it again with a code.
pairing_code_invalid: This pairing code is not valid. Ask the main PC for a new code.
pairing_code_expired: This pairing code has expired (10 minutes). Ask the main PC for a new code.
terminal_code_invalid: A till series is letters and digits, a letter first (C2, C3…), at most 8 characters.
terminal_code_taken: Another PC already uses this series. Choose another one.
snapshot_invalid: The copy received from the main PC is incomplete or damaged. Join the main PC again with a new pairing code.
lan_role_invalid: This PC does not have the right role for this (single PC, main PC or till).
lan_tills_paired: Tills are still linked to this main PC. Remove them first.
lan_outbox_not_empty: This till still has operations to send to the main PC. Reconnect it and wait until they are sent.
lan_restore_blocked: This backup, or this PC, is part of a group of linked tills: restoring it would put its data back in time behind the other PCs. A till joins its main PC again instead. If the main PC is broken, make a till the main PC (Settings › Network, "Make this the main PC").
lan_not_paired: This till is not linked to a main PC. Join the main PC with a code.
lan_clock_skew: This PC's clock is too far from the main PC's. Set the Windows time right, then open the till.
lan_port_busy: Another program (perhaps a second copy of DZBuild POS) already uses network port 7345 on this PC. Close it, then try again.
lan_rate_limited: Too many tries in a short time. Wait a minute and try again.
lan_discovery_failed: Searching the network for the main PC could not start. Type its address (shown on the main PC).
lan_offline: The main PC does not answer. Selling goes on on this till; operations will be sent as soon as it is back.
lan_address_invalid: Invalid main PC address. Example: 192.168.1.10 or 192.168.1.10:7345.
replay_rejected: The main PC refused an operation of this till. The next ones wait: tell the owner.
lan_vault_unavailable: Windows Credential Manager does not answer, so this till's network access code could not be read or saved. Restart the PC.
kridi_needs_host: Customer credit (kridi) needs the main PC to answer: balances live there. Take another payment or wait for the connection.
outbox_pending_at_close: Operations of this till not yet on the main PC: {{pending}}. Wait until they are sent, or close an offline Z with a manager's approval.
offline_z_needs_approval: An offline Z needs a manager's approval.
rpc_service_not_found: The main PC does not know this operation. Put both PCs on the same version.
lan_host_alive: The main PC still answers. A till is made the main PC only when the old one is gone for good.
lan_catching_up: The main PC recorded the operation; this till is still receiving its data. Try again in a moment.
cloud_unlink_first: This PC is linked to the DZBuild store “{{store}}” (uploads waiting: {{pending}}): unlink it in Settings › DZBuild before joining the main PC.
mirror_unavailable: The USB stick or the folder for the second copy cannot be reached. Plug the stick in (or check the folder) and try again.
mirror_not_configured: No folder is chosen for the second copy. Choose a USB stick or a folder in Settings › Backups.
database_missing: The shop's data file is missing, but backups exist. Restore the newest one from this screen.
restore_already_scheduled: A restore is already scheduled. Restart DZBuild POS to apply it.
recovery_not_available: The guided restore is only for when the shop's data does not open. Use Settings › Backups.
update_endpoint_invalid: The update address is not valid. It must start with https:// and contain /stable/.
update_corrupt: The update file is incomplete or altered. It was deleted; try again later.
update_check_failed: DZBuild POS could not check for updates (no Internet, or the update site does not answer). It will try again later by itself.
update_not_available: No update is available for this PC.
update_not_ready: The update is still downloading or being checked. Wait a moment, then try again.
update_busy: An update check or download is already running.
update_blocked: A cash drawer is open. Close the till (Z) before installing the update.
update_too_old: This version is too old to update by itself. Download the full installer from dzbuild.com/pos.
demo_active: The demo shop is open. Leave the demo before erasing it.
support_contact_missing: No support contact is saved. The owner can add it in Settings › Diagnostic.
demo_not_allowed: Not possible in the demo shop: it has no fiscal value and never touches the network, DZBuild or the real shop's backups. Leave the demo to do it in your shop.
backup_is_demo: This backup is the demo shop's: it cannot replace your shop. Choose another backup.
mirror_invalid: This folder is inside DZBuild POS's data folder: it would not be a real second copy. Choose a USB stick or a folder on another disk.
mirror_cloud_folder: This folder is synced with an online service (OneDrive, Google Drive, Dropbox): your sales, customers and PINs would go to the Internet unencrypted. Choose a USB stick or a local folder.
module_disabled: This module is off. Turn it on in Settings › Activity and modules.
price_above_ceiling: This price is above the regulated ceiling of this subsidised product. Lower it to the ceiling.
regulated_code_unknown: This regulated product is not in the regulatory data pack.
department_key_not_found: This department key no longer exists.
dining_room_not_found: This dining room no longer exists.
dining_ticket_not_found: This table ticket no longer exists.
dining_line_not_found: This line is no longer on the ticket.
modifier_group_not_found: This modifier group no longer exists.
table_cell_invalid: This cell is outside the room's plan.
table_cell_taken: A table already sits on this cell.
table_code_taken: Another table already has this number.
table_busy: This table has an open ticket. Take its payment or move it first.
ticket_not_open: This ticket is already paid or voided.
ticket_needs_place: Choose a table or a named ticket (Counter…).
modifier_choice_invalid: The options chosen do not fit: check the required choices and the maximum.
line_already_sent: This line already went to the kitchen: void it with a reason.
kitchen_nothing_to_send: Everything already went to the kitchen.
kitchen_ticket_not_found: This kitchen ticket no longer exists.
split_invalid: Choose at least one line to move, and leave at least one.
kitchen_station_not_found: This preparation station no longer exists.
register_entry_required: This controlled medicine must be entered in the register: type the prescriber, the prescription and the patient.
chifa_list_invalid: The Chifa list has rows to fix; nothing was imported.
yield_template_not_found: This cutting template no longer exists.
yield_shares_invalid: The expected shares add up to more than the whole carcass.
yield_output_exceeds_input: The cuts weigh more than the carcass: check the weights.
yield_source_short: There is not enough carcass in stock for this weight.
serials_required: Scan the serial number (IMEI) of every device sold or returned.
imei_invalid: This IMEI is not valid: check the 15 digits.
buyer_required: This item has a warranty: choose or create the customer for its certificate.
serial_not_on_line: This serial number was not sold on this line of the receipt.
flexy_operator_unknown: This operator is not set up for top-ups.
flexy_float_insufficient: This operator's top-up float is too low: record a float purchase.
deposit_owner_invalid: This deposit cannot be taken for this document.
deposit_insufficient: The deposit held does not cover this amount.
voucher_unknown: This number matches no order, voucher or service ticket.
service_ticket_not_found: This service ticket no longer exists.
service_status_invalid: This status change is not possible.
deposit_held: A deposit is still held: refund it before closing the ticket.
flexy_float_not_found: This top-up float entry no longer exists.
instalment_nothing_financed: The down payment covers the whole price: make an ordinary sale.
instalment_count_invalid: Choose a number of instalments between 1 and the set maximum.
instalment_due_unknown: This instalment is not in the contract.
below_min_order: Quantity below this product's minimum order.
customer_price_invalid: Enter a customer price above zero for a sellable product.
pack_units_invalid: A pack holds at least 2 whole units of the product.
round_status_invalid: This action is not possible in the round's current state.
round_stop_invalid: Choose a validated delivery note or invoice, with a customer, not already on an open round.
collection_above_due: The amount collected is more than the customer owes on this document.
van_location_invalid: This stock location is not an active delivery vehicle.
order_status_invalid: This order is already fulfilled or closed.
layaway_not_paid: A layaway is paid in full: nothing may be left on credit.
layaway_deposit_too_low: The deposit is below the minimum set for a layaway.
appointment_overlap: This person already has an appointment at that time.
appointment_time_invalid: Choose a length of 5 minutes to 10 hours for an appointment still booked.
loyalty_card_invalid: This loyalty card code is not valid or already used.
loyalty_not_enrolled: This customer has no loyalty card: enrol them first.
points_below_minimum: A loyalty voucher needs at least the set minimum of points.
points_insufficient: The customer does not have enough points.
voucher_expired: This voucher has expired: it is no longer accepted as payment.
voucher_balance_insufficient: This voucher's balance is below the amount entered.
jewel_piece_invalid: Check the piece's metal, fineness (1 to 1000 ‰) and weight.
metal_price_missing: Enter the price per gram of this metal and fineness first.
buyer_identity_required: Selling jewellery needs the buyer's name, identity document and address.
cash_above_limit: This cash amount is above the limit set for precious metals: pay the rest by card, cheque or transfer.
staff_amount_invalid: Enter an amount above zero (commission rate: 0 to 50 %).
advance_repay_too_much: This amount is more than the employee still owes on advances.
zakat_statement_not_found: This zakat calculation no longer exists.
zakat_nisab_missing: Enter the nisab of the current Hijri year on the Zakat screen first.
payment_type_not_found: This payment type no longer exists.
payment_type_code_taken: Another payment type already has this code.
payment_type_mismatch: This payment type does not match the tender chosen.
label_barcode_invalid: This code cannot be printed with this type of barcode (Code 39: capitals and digits; ITF: an even number of digits).
count_lot_required: This product is counted lot by lot in this stock count: enter the quantity of each lot.
product_not_lot_tracked: This product is not tracked by lot: count it without a lot number.
datapack_signature_invalid: This regulatory file does not come from DZBuild (its signature is missing or wrong), so it was not installed.
datapack_file_invalid: This regulatory file is unreadable or incomplete.
datapack_older: This regulatory file is not newer than the one in use.
key_map_invalid: Choose a free key among F1 to F12 (except F11), Ctrl+0 to Ctrl+9 or Esc.
customer_has_open_items: This customer still has a balance, a deposit, an order, a repair, a voucher or an appointment open: settle them first.
license_required: This PC has no DZBuild POS licence: you can view, export and back up your data, but not sell or change anything. Activate a licence in Settings › Licence.
license_expired: The trial has ended: your data can still be viewed, exported and backed up. To sell again, activate a lifetime licence in Settings › Licence.
license_tampered: This PC's licence data was altered. Sales are blocked; your data can still be viewed. Send DZBuild this PC's code to activate the licence again.
license_invalid: This text is not a valid DZBuild POS licence key. Copy the whole key DZBuild sent you (it starts with DZL1.) or load the .dzlic file.
license_wrong_device: This key was issued for another PC. Send DZBuild this PC's code to receive the right key.
license_trial_used: This PC has already used its trial. Activate a lifetime licence.
license_clock_behind: This PC's date is behind: behind the key's date or, during a trial, behind the newest date this PC has shown (the trial counts from it). Set the Windows date and time right, then try again.
license_revoked: DZBuild cancelled this key (replaced PC or refund). Contact DZBuild for a new key.
license_downgrade: This PC already has a lifetime licence: a trial key cannot replace it.
license_device_unreadable: Windows does not give this PC's identity, so no licence can be checked. Restart the PC; if it continues, contact DZBuild support.
lan_answer_pending: The main PC's answer did not arrive in time. The operation is kept on this till and will be sent again automatically until it goes through: keep the money and do not enter it again.
return_host_pending: This sale's entries (register, IMEI, balances) have not reached the main PC yet. Try again once the main PC has recorded them (Settings › Network).
